lint.disposition: All remaining errors are legacy exhaustive-deps findings, not individually confirmed runtime bugs. Still open for individual lifecycle review; no blanket dependency autofix or rule disabling.

import_cleanup.method: Each removed import binding was checked for exact emitted Babel output equality in both development and production before later independent application fixes. This is an import-only check, not an equivalence claim for the complete patch. The final unused useMemo import was then removed after replacing its network use with an effect.

cleanup_safeguards: Preserve callback argument positions, public generic call signatures and TypeScript parameter annotations.
Retain existing hook calls/order and side-effecting initializer calls even when their result is unused.
Keep return values/error handling, notification registrations, analytics payloads, Realm writes, backup readers and encryption envelopes unchanged.
Remove only unreferenced local functions/types/values; no object-rest exclusions or computed/default destructuring rewritten.
Two scoped lint exceptions: fixed checked-in test fixture compilation and an existing unused public generic type parameter. No shared ESLint rule changed.
